The game's clever use of power-ups, obstacles, and a ticking clock adds a layer of complexity that will keep you hooked. Power-ups, such as the hammer and the star, can be used to clear large sections of the board or create new matches. Obstacles, like the ice and the stone, can block your path and make it harder to clear the board. And the clock? Well, that's the pressure that will keep you on your toes.
